```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)

features <- tibble(features = raw$features)
features

features <- features |> unnest_wider(features)
features

features <- features |> unnest_wider(properties)
features

fires <- features |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )

first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)

first_coordinate <- first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
first_coordinate
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |> dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(incident, "August"))
nrow(august_fires)

fires |> dplyr::arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
fires |>
  dplyr::group_by(fire_year) |>
  dplyr::summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned per Year",
    x = "Fire Year",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Source: wildfire incident records"
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lon = purrr::map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(boundary) {
      mean(purrr::map_dbl(boundary[[1]], \(pair) pair[[1]]))
    }),
    lat = purrr::map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(boundary) {
      mean(purrr::map_dbl(boundary[[1]], \(pair) pair[[2]]))
    })
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires |>
  dplyr::count(agency) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = reorder(agency, n), y = n)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Number of Big Fires by Managing Agency",
    x = "Managing Agency",
    y = "Number of Fires"
  )
```

```{r}
ten_fires <- big_fires |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)

boundary_coordinates <- purrr::map(
  ten_fires$geometry_coordinates,
  \(boundary) cbind(
    purrr::map_dbl(boundary[[1]], \(pair) pair[[1]]),
    purrr::map_dbl(boundary[[1]], \(pair) pair[[2]])
  )
)
all_coordinates <- do.call(rbind, boundary_coordinates)

fire_map <- leaflet::leaflet() |> leaflet::addTiles()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ten_fires))) {
  fire <- ten_fires[i, ]
  fire_map <- fire_map |>
    leaflet::addPolygons(
      lng = boundary_coordinates[[i]][, 1],
      lat = boundary_coordinates[[i]][, 2],
      popup = paste0(
        "<strong>", fire$incident, "</strong><br>",
        "Year: ", fire$fire_year, "<br>",
        "Acres: ", format(fire$gis_acres, big.mark = ",")
      )
    )
}

fire_map |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(all_coordinates[, 1]),
    lat1 = min(all_coordinates[, 2]),
    lng2 = max(all_coordinates[, 1]),
    lat2 = max(all_coordinates[, 2])
  )
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- readRDS("data/imdb_snapshots.rds")

rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  dplyr::filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10) |>
  dplyr::select(title, release_decade, snap_year, rank) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015,
    absolute_change = abs(rank_change)
  )

rank_changes |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(absolute_change)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::select(title, release_decade, rank_2015, rank_2022, rank_change)

average_rank_changes <- rank_changes |>
  dplyr::group_by(release_decade) |>
  dplyr::summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(release_decade)

average_rank_changes |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = dplyr::if_else(
      average_rank_change > 0,
      "Rank rose",
      "Rank fell"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = average_rank_change,
      y = factor(release_decade, levels = sort(unique(release_decade))),
      fill = direction
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rank rose" = "#D55E00", "Rank fell" = "#0072B2")) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate that films moved down the rankings",
    x = "Average Rank Change (2022 rank - 2015 rank)",
    y = "Release Decade",
    fill = "Rank Direction",
    caption = "Based on 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

scrape_snapshot <- \(address, snapshot_year) {
  response <- httr2::request(address) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(120) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    httr2::req_perform()

  page <- response |>
    httr2::resp_body_string() |>
    rvest::read_html()

  table <- page |> rvest::html_table() |> purrr::pluck(1)
  rating_tooltips <- page |>
    rvest::html_elements(".ratingColumn.imdbRating [title]") |>
    rvest::html_attr("title")

  tibble::tibble(
    raw_rank_title = table[[2]],
    rating = as.numeric(table[[3]]),
    tooltip = rating_tooltips
  ) |>
    tidyr::extract(
      raw_rank_title,
      into = c("rank", "title", "year"),
      regex = "^\\s*(\\d+)\\.\\s+(.*)\\s+\\((\\d{4})\\)\\s*$",
      convert = TRUE
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      snap_year = snapshot_year,
      rank,
      title,
      year,
      rating,
      number = readr::parse_number(
        stringr::str_extract(tooltip, "[0-9,]+(?= votes)")
      )
    )
}

imdb_snapshots <- purrr::map2(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()
```
